title: T4 task manifest
description: Declarative manifest for one T4 task family / semantic task. The Go source of record is a package under tasks/<family>/; this schema is the language-neutral contract that source is expected to satisfy and that a Java (or other) adapter must mirror. It freezes the benchmark contract: identity definition, payload fingerprint, expected outcome, invariants, rail profile, schedules, and the reference/mutant set.

semantic_task_id.description: Language-independent semantic task id (e.g. capture-t1). Go and Java instances of the same semantic task share this id and must pass semantic-parity tests.

family.description: Task family the semantic task belongs to.

tier.description: Difficulty tier. Tier 1 = single-mechanism reserve-then-effect (shipped). Tiers 2-3 = compounded hazards (future work).

prompt.description: Natural-language task description handed to the generator (see generation/prompts/).

interface.description: The candidate interface the generator must implement.

method.description: The single request-handling method (e.g. Capture(Request) harness.Response).

factory.description: Signature of the factory that binds an injected Env to a fresh candidate (e.g. func(env harness.Env) Service).

allowed_deps.description: Packages/modules the candidate may import. Empty or [t4bench/harness] only for Tier-1 Go tasks: no real clock/rand/network/goroutines/globals.

limits.description: Resource/behaviour bounds enforced by the harness or checked at authoring time.

max_recovery_steps.description: Bound on injected ops in a recovery pass before non-convergence is declared.

max_run_steps.description: Bound on injected ops in a single request run before divergence is declared.

identity.description: Definition of the operation identity used for provider-side deduplication. 'Same identity' must be unambiguous: a raw caller key is insufficient (threat T22).

fields.description: The components that together define one operation identity.

key_format.description: How the fields are joined into the canonical dedup key (e.g. Merchant|Op|Resource|CallerKey).

payload_fingerprint.description: How the request payload is fingerprinted so a replay of the same identity with a changed payload can be rejected with CONFLICT.

fields.description: Payload fields that participate in the fingerprint (e.g. Amount, Currency).

expected_outcome.description: The financial ground truth after stabilization, independent of any candidate.

total_effects.description: Exact number of external effects that must exist on the rail after the schedule stabilizes.

distinct_identities.description: Number of distinct effect-identities expected (false-dedup detection).

eligible_identities.description: Identities that must end resolved after recovery.

conflict_instances.description: Instance ids whose observable response must be CONFLICT.

invariants.description: The financial-safety invariants scored for this task (the shared six).

schedules.description: The fault schedules for this task, partitioned into public (development) and hidden (scoring).

reference_hash.description: SHA-256 of the frozen correct-reference source, so a released task cannot be silently altered.

mutants.description: The seeded-bug mutants shipped with the task. Each breaks exactly one invariant under the assumed rail profile.

target_invariant.description: The single invariant this mutant is designed to violate.

description.description: What the seeded bug is (e.g. time-based idempotency key).
